{{family name hatnote|Mejías|Hurtado|lang=Spanish}}
'''Daniel Mejías Hurtado''' (26 July 1982 – 8 November 2022) was an Andorran [[association football|footballer]] who played as a [[midfielder]]. He made five appearances for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]], having made his international debut in 2010.<ref>{{NFT player|38599|name=Daniel Mejías}}</ref>

Mejías died on 8 November 2022, aged 40.<ref>{{cite web |author1=Jordi Cumplido |title=Muere a los 40 años el exfutbolista Dani Mejías tras un desgraciado suceso |url=https://espanadiario.es/actualidad/muere-exfutbolista-dani-mejias |website=EspañaDiario.es |access-date=30 December 2022 |date=10 November 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Mor l'exfutbolista de la selecció de futbol andorrana Daniel Mejías |url=https://www.ara.ad/esports/mor-l-exfutbolista-seleccio-futbol-andorrana-daniel-mejias_1_4543571.html |website=Ara Andorra |access-date=30 December 2022 |date=10 November 2022}}</ref>
